title: Near-death experiencers describe living buildings with doors that open like molten metal

tellings.quote: I've got a whole list of maybe 20 so far.

plain: A researcher named Grant Cameron, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that people who have had near-death experiences, meaning they nearly died and later described what they saw, report buildings that seem alive, with doors that open like molten metal. Cameron says he has gathered a list of maybe 20 such accounts so far. He tells it because, if true, many people would be describing the same strange place on the edge of death.
